meta.title: LiberiaLearn — December Product Assurance + Red-Team Audit V1
meta.scope: Repository-level assurance across nine lenses: student, teacher, guardian, admin/MOE, child privacy + security, accessibility + low-end UX, operations + support, failure/recovery, product reachability. No architecture redesign, no curriculum extraction, North-Star audit not rerun.
meta.external_constraints: Supabase and Vercel were unavailable. No live database, RLS, feature-flag, blob-store, or deployed-runtime verification was performed; every result below is repository evidence.

summary.verdict: No P0 defect was found. All eight P1 repository defects are fixed, and each is covered by a test that fails on the base commit and passes after the fix. The seven documented P2 items each need a child-privacy, educational-authority, product, or infrastructure decision; none is a hidden cross-tenant exposure. This change adds no parallel educational authority: every fix narrows an existing route or makes it consistent with an existing convention.

findings.title: Open redirect after login and step-up
findings.evidence: isNextUrlSafeForRole accepted any value starting with '/', so /login?next=//evil.example sent a user to another origin via router.push after a successful sign-in. The step-up check rejected '//' but not '/\evil.example', which browsers normalise to '//'. The Auth0 button forwarded ?next= unvalidated.
findings.impact: Credential phishing aimed at teachers, admins, and guardians right after a genuine login.
findings.fix: Shared isSafeInternalPath rejects protocol-relative, backslash, and control-character paths; used by login, step-up, and the Auth0 callback.

findings.title: All email logins shared one global rate-limit bucket
findings.evidence: studentId defaulted to "" and the key used '??', so every email login resolved to the key 'credentials:'. checkRateLimit counts every attempt (successful ones included) with a limit of 10 per 15 minutes, on the shared store in production.
findings.impact: After about 10 email sign-ins nationwide in 15 minutes, every email login is refused with a generic failure: a national login outage that support cannot diagnose. It also means no per-account brute-force protection for email accounts.
findings.fix: Identifiers fall through with '||'; email logins are keyed per address ('email:<address>').
findings.external: Rate-limit backend (Redis) behaviour could not be observed live.

findings.title: Grading idempotency keys replayed another learner's submission
findings.evidence: Both routes returned gradedSubmission.findUnique({ clientSubmissionId }) without checking studentId. Homework and essay routes already bind the key to the learner.
findings.impact: A student who obtained another student's client submission ID could read that student's response text, score, and feedback.
findings.fix: A key bound to a different learner returns 409 idempotency_key_payload_mismatch, matching /api/homework/submit.

findings.title: Teacher free-text notes about one child published on the national dashboard
findings.evidence: Each district's topOverrideReason was the most frequent teacherReason: free text of at least 20 characters written about one learner at placement override. Because free text rarely repeats, the 'top' reason was usually one child's note, shown verbatim to national officials.
findings.impact: Individual learner circumstances (names, family situation) crossed from school scope to national scope, against the MOE 'aggregates only' contract.
findings.fix: A reason is published only when at least 5 overrides share it (the same small-cell rule as the county dashboard); otherwise null ('--').

findings.title: National WAEC readiness county ranking had no small-cell suppression
findings.evidence: byCounty published avgReadiness and assessedStudents for every county, including counties with one assessed learner. The MOE county and dashboard routes suppress cohorts below 5.
findings.impact: A county with a single Grade 9+ assessed learner revealed that learner's readiness score.
findings.fix: Counties with fewer than 5 assessed learners return suppressed: true with null values; the panel shows 'Too few learners to show'.

findings.title: School admins could read the national WAEC aggregate
findings.evidence: ALLOWED included ADMIN. Every other /api/moe aggregate uses isMoeSuperRole, and the only consumer (WaecMoePanel) renders on /moe/dashboard, which middleware blocks for ADMIN.
findings.impact: School-scoped role reading national data it has no UI for.
findings.fix: Limited to MOE_OFFICIAL, MOE_SUPER_ADMIN, and platform admin.

findings.title: Unknown placement override rate shown as 0%
findings.evidence: overrideRate and nationalOverrideRate returned 0 when no placement had been reviewed.
findings.impact: Unknown presented as zero: suggests the AI placement is never overridden when nobody has reviewed it.

findings.title: Admin could mint a public share link for another school's learner
findings.evidence: Students were ownership-checked; ADMIN had no school check. The response creates a CertificateShare token and a public URL with WhatsApp text containing the learner's full name.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant write that publishes a minor's name and achievement from another school.
findings.fix: Non-platform admins must share the learner's school (404 otherwise), matching /api/certificates/generate.

findings.title: Guardian dashboard showed AI homework scores before review
findings.evidence: recentGrades used teacherScore ?? aiScore without checking aiReviewed. /api/guardian/students, /api/guardian/student/[id], and /api/homework/[id] all withhold aiScore until aiReviewed.
findings.impact: Provisional machine scores shown to families as grades, unlabeled.
findings.fix: AI score shown only when aiReviewed, matching the other guardian and student surfaces; the visibility predicate is part of the query so the 5-grade limit counts only visible grades.

findings.title: Public /api/health/db returned raw database driver errors
findings.evidence: On failure the unauthenticated route returned err.message, which for Prisma connection errors names the database host and port.
findings.impact: Infrastructure reconnaissance from an unauthenticated endpoint.
findings.fix: Returns 'database_unreachable' outside development; the full message stays in the server log.

findings.title: Learner transcripts and message attachments at predictable public blob URLs; transcript regeneration silently stale
findings.evidence: @vercel/blob 2.3.3 does not add a random suffix by default. Transcripts were written to public 'portfolios/{studentId}/{term}/transcript.html' and attachments to 'message-attachments/{userId}/{timestamp}_{name}'. Blob v2 also refuses to overwrite, so regenerating a transcript threw inside a swallowed catch and left the old public copy in place.
findings.impact: A minor's name, school, scores, and attendance were retrievable by anyone who knew or guessed a learner ID and term. Regenerated credentials kept serving stale numbers.
findings.fix: addRandomSuffix: true on all three public writes; each regeneration gets a new URL, which is stored on the credential.
findings.external: Earlier blobs already written at predictable paths stay public until removed from the Vercel Blob store (needs Vercel access).

findings.title: Report card double-publish sent duplicate notifications
findings.evidence: Check-then-update: two concurrent PATCHes (double-click, retry) both saw DRAFT, both updated, and both sent push and inbox notifications to the student and every guardian.
findings.impact: Duplicate family notifications; confusing publish state.
findings.fix: Conditional updateMany (status != PUBLISHED); the losing request returns 'Already published' and sends nothing.

findings.title: Teacher override of AI essay/code grades was unaudited
findings.evidence: The route overwrote gradedSubmission.score with no audit record and no trace of the previous score. Assignment grading and placement review both audit.
findings.impact: Grade changes invisible to reviewers; no way to tell an AI grade from a human override afterwards.
findings.fix: Writes a grading.submission.override audit entry with the previous and new score.

findings.title: '+ Create Homework' led to a missing homework page
findings.evidence: Both Create Homework buttons linked to /teacher/homework/create; the page is /teacher/homework/new, so 'create' was treated as a homework ID by /teacher/homework/[id].
findings.impact: Teachers could not create homework from the Homework screen: a core December workflow dead end.

findings.title: Links to routes that do not exist
location: components/GlobalSearch.tsx (/events; student lesson links for teachers)
findings.evidence: Static href scan against the app route tree (dynamic segments resolved) found these literal targets with no page.
findings.impact: Navigation dead ends. The 'Review intervention' alert action (the teacher intervention follow-up) went to a 404.
findings.fix: Pointed to existing routes: /admin, /guardian/progress, /teacher/intelligence (hosts the intervention table), /guardian/register, and role-aware search results. The MOE audit tile was removed; see DA-24.

findings.title: Primary buttons failed WCAG AA contrast
location: ~110 buttons across app/ and components/ using bg-[var(--ll-yellow)] or bg-[var(--ll-accent)]
findings.evidence: Text token --ll-text-faint (#6b6460) on --ll-yellow (#E8B84B) measures 3.15:1; some buttons used --ll-text or white, which is lower still. Many switched on hover to the 11%-alpha yellow, which would make dark text disappear.
findings.impact: Low-legibility primary actions (Sign in, Submit, Retry) on low-end, outdoor-lit phone screens.
findings.fix: Solid yellow/accent surfaces use --ll-bg text (9.45:1) and hover:opacity-90. Colours and tokens are unchanged, so the visual identity holds.

findings.title: Icon-only controls without accessible names
findings.evidence: Month navigation and a modal close button had only an icon; the calendar buttons were 28px touch targets.
findings.impact: Screen readers announce 'button' with no purpose; small targets on phones.
findings.fix: aria-labels added; calendar buttons use the 44px minimum target.

findings.title: Error and offline pages falsely claimed work was saved
findings.evidence: 'Your work has been saved' was shown for every unexpected error and every offline navigation, including online-only flows that the offline queue reports as unsupported_offline.
findings.impact: Misleading success state: learners do not redo work that was lost.
findings.fix: Honest wording plus a pointer to the error reference; SW_VERSION bumped so installed clients refresh the precached offline page.

findings.title: Portfolio share page ignored the portfolio feature flag
findings.evidence: GET /api/portfolio/[shareCode] returns 404 when feature:portfolio is off; the page route read the share and rendered the learner's name and school regardless.
findings.impact: Turning the feature off did not stop learner data being served.
findings.fix: The page returns notFound() when the flag is off.

findings.title: AI homework scores reach families without human approval
findings.evidence: aiReviewed is set by the AI review pipeline itself, not by a teacher. After DA-09 every guardian surface consistently shows aiScore once aiReviewed is set, labelled '(AI)'. AssignmentSubmission, by contrast, requires teacherApproved before a score is released.
findings.impact: An LLM-produced score is released to families without teacher approval, which CORE_AGENT_RULES says only governed systems or humans may decide.
findings.external: Decision owner: curriculum/assessment governance. Options: gate on teacherScore, or add a teacherApproved flag like AssignmentSubmission.

findings.title: 'Advisory' LLM grades update adaptive mastery
findings.evidence: Route headers say the LLM grade is advisory, yet each calls recordAnswer(correct = score >= threshold) on the adaptive mastery store.
findings.impact: An LLM judgement becomes mastery evidence without human review.

findings.title: Portfolio 'share' links require a LiberiaLearn login
findings.evidence: /portfolio is not a public path, so external recipients hit the login redirect. Any signed-in user in any school can open a share code.
findings.impact: The feature does not work for its intended audience, and its access model is undefined.
findings.fix_status: documented — material child-privacy policy decision (TRUE STOP)
findings.external: Decision owner: child-privacy governance (public vs. authenticated share, expiry).

findings.title: Transcripts and message attachments remain public-access blobs
findings.evidence: After DA-11 the URLs are unguessable but still public and non-expiring.
findings.impact: A forwarded link grants permanent access to a minor's attachment or transcript.
findings.fix_status: documented — needs infrastructure (private blob store + signed delivery route)
findings.external: Vercel Blob private store and a policy decision on transcript sharing.

findings.title: No MOE audit-trail surface
findings.evidence: The dashboard linked to /moe/audit, which does not exist; the dead tile was removed (DA-15). /admin/audit is ADMIN-only.
findings.impact: National officials cannot review access to national data.
findings.fix_status: documented — policy decision on what MOE may see of the audit log

findings.title: Implemented pages with no navigation entry
findings.evidence: Static scan found no literal or dynamic link to these pages. Labs are linked dynamically and are not included.
findings.impact: Weekly offline packs, which matter for December offline delivery, and the learning passport are only reachable by typing the URL.
findings.fix_status: documented — product decision (nav placement, feature flag readiness)

findings.title: No operator view of a learner's stuck offline queue
findings.evidence: The sync route returns structured resolutionHint codes and emits an offline.queue.conflicts gauge, but no admin surface lists one learner's rejected or conflicted operations. withRequestLogging wraps only 6 of 579 API routes.
findings.impact: Support can see that sync is failing in aggregate but cannot answer 'why is this learner's work missing'.
findings.fix_status: documented — new operator surface; outside a defect fix

findings.title: Certificate share tokens cannot be revoked
findings.evidence: Tokens are a deterministic HMAC of the certificate ID with no expiry and a 'dev-fallback-secret' fallback when NEXTAUTH_SECRET is missing.
findings.impact: A shared certificate stays public for good; the fallback secret is unsafe if production is ever misconfigured (NextAuth would also fail in that case).

findings.title: Essay/code grade override is school-scoped, not class-scoped
findings.evidence: Any teacher in the school may override any learner's graded submission; the route-policy declares school-membership. The override is now audited (DA-13).
findings.impact: Wider than assignment grading, which is limited to the class teacher.

findings.title: Duplicate assignment creation page
findings.evidence: Both post to /api/teacher/assignments; only /new is linked.
findings.impact: Maintenance drift only; no parallel authority.

findings.title: Ops health page links to a repository runbook the app does not serve
findings.evidence: No route serves /docs/*.
findings.impact: Operator dead link during an incident.

findings.title: Many routes return raw exception messages on 500
findings.evidence: Common pattern: NextResponse.json({ error: err?.message }). All of these routes require authentication.
findings.impact: Possible internal detail disclosure to signed-in users; low individual risk.
findings.fix_status: documented — broad cleanup, best done through handleApiError

Error/offline states are honest about unsaved work
Learner submissions isolated from other learners
Student detail and intelligence limited to the teacher's enrolled students

Placement override transactional and audited
Create homework from the Homework screen
Intervention alert → review intervention
Grade overrides are traceable
Every child-data route verifies the guardian↔student link for the requested child
Messages go only to a teacher of the linked child; read receipts recipient-only
Only published report cards visible

MOE county and dashboard aggregates suppress cohorts below 5
MOE WAEC and placement aggregates free of individual facts
Portal middleware: /moe MOE-only, /admin ADMIN-only, /platform platform-admin-only
All 579 API routes scanned for missing authentication
journeys.evidence: Only intentional public routes lack session checks (health, auth, enroll/register, onboarding accept, SMS webhooks with provider checks, dev route blocked in production); cron routes verify CRON_SECRET

journeys.check: Tenant boundaries on ID-addressed routes (sampled 30+ [id] routes)
journeys.evidence: DA-08; all other sampled routes scope by schoolId, enrollment, or link

journeys.check: Post-login redirect and login throttling
Primary action contrast and icon-button names
Error pages expose a support reference (digest) without internals
Double-submit of report card publish
Homework and quiz retry after lost response
journeys.evidence: app/api/homework/submit/route.ts (key bound to learner and payload); quiz clientAttemptId replay

journeys.check: Literal navigation targets resolve to routes

external_only: Supabase: verify RLS, tenant data, and that no stale public transcripts exist at portfolios/{studentId}/… paths (DA-11).
Vercel: confirm feature:portfolio and guardian/MOE flag values for December, and confirm the production rate-limit backend is the shared store (DA-02).
Vercel Blob: remove or rotate transcripts and message attachments written before this change at predictable paths (DA-11).
Deployed PWA: confirm installed clients pick up SW_VERSION p5e-2026-09-24-1 and the revised offline page.
next_mission: December Governance Decisions + Operator Readiness: (1) take DA-20, DA-21, and DA-22 to curriculum/child-privacy governance and implement the chosen AI-score release and portfolio-share policies; (2) build a read-only operator 'learner sync and submission' diagnostic view (DA-26) keyed by learner and school, with resolutionHint history; (3) once Supabase/Vercel return, run live verification of DA-02 and DA-11 cleanup and the flag matrix; (4) add nav entries for offline packs and the passport if the flags are December-ready (DA-25).
